newsitem.title: UK: Brit Gas gains on hopes for Ofgas review.
newsitem.headline: Brit Gas gains on hopes for Ofgas review.

text.p: British Gas shares rose on Thursday despite a fall in first-half profits after the company said it was closer to regulator Ofgas on a price review and was trying to settle a dispute over transmission operation Transco.
British Gas shares climbed as high as 201p, reversing modest early losses, but slipped back by 0808 GMT to trade at 200p, up one pence on the day. The FTSE 100 index was up 0.23 percent.

"The figures were more or less in line with expectations. But the attempt to resolve the dispute with Ofgas is helping the shares. It is far better than having the Monopolies and Mergers Commission involved," one market maker said.

British Gas Richard Giordano told Reuters he expected the domestic price review to be settled by the end of September or mid-October, saying "my guess is that we are closer to Ofgas and Ofgas is closer to us on that review."
